URL: https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/middle-east/iran-us-war-live-trump-amazon-bahrain-attack-strait-hormuz-b3018601.html
NOTE: The Independent live (approved), Tue 21 Jul updates 05:40-08:13 BST. Oil held near one-month high Tuesday: Brent -0.4% to $88.87/bbl, WTI steady $82.47; both near Monday highs when Brent broke $90 first time in a month; slight retreat after 10-day ceasefire mediation reports. YEMEN'S HOUTHIS declared naval blockade on Saudi Arabia — "a maritime embargo against the criminal Saudi enemy, based on the equation of 'an eye for an eye', effective immediately" — in response to alleged Saudi siege of Yemen; widens supply threat to Red Sea beyond the Gulf. IRGC claimed strike on Amazon central data infrastructure in Bahrain (Tasnim; unverified by Reuters/Bahrain). Iran claimed drone attacks on 3 US installations in Kuwait; claimed hit on missile-defence radar + F-15 shelter in Jordan. IRGC statement: "[Trump] should know that, by God's grace, even if this war lasts for several years, until the very last day, our missiles and drones will rain down on American criminals." US completed 10th consecutive night (~5 hrs) hitting command centres, missile/drone launch sites, maritime capabilities, air defences to "degrade Iran's ability to continue attacking commercial vessels" in Hormuz. Israeli strikes killed at least 5 Palestinians across Gaza Tuesday (Jabalia shelter + Khan Younis vehicle; via Anadolu).
